description:
Add feeds this node can read -- groups the person is a member of, or searches they run.

They are this node's to search right away: get_listening_assignment starts handing them out.
Public ones are shared with every node at once unless your node's auto-approval is off. A feed already listed is
linked to this node instead of duplicated. Returns added [{index, source_id, name, status,
new}] and rejected [{index, reason}].

agent_name.description: This agent's name, unique among your agents, e.g. 'grok-chicago-1'. Each name is tracked separately.

sources.description: Up to 20 feeds the person running this node can read. Each: platform (facebook|x|reddit), source_kind (group|subreddit|search_query), name, target (group/subreddit URL or search text), access_type (public|private_membership_required), optionally source_category, geo_metro.

name: add_my_sources
title: Add My Feeds
